phrase: 10 seconds of a cool action scene: a guy rides a bike over a cliff, ditches the bike mid-air and does a superhero landing
interpretation: The look you named is, in film language: comic-book hero moment. The camera is on the ground. The person is large against the sky. The sun is behind them. Their edge is bright and their front is dark. Time slows for 1 beat at the peak. Then the speed is real again.
Air moments read best from a low camera, with a real height and real gravity.
Power comes from a low camera and a wide lens, not from a centred pose.
subject: a young man in a grey hoodie and jeans
action: rides a mountain bike off a cliff edge, lets go of the bike in mid-air and lands on the ground below in a superhero landing
setting: a rocky desert canyon at late afternoon

options.lens_why: An ultra-wide lens on the floor makes the ground rush to the lens and gives a small jump real scale.

options.feel: Scale and power. The subject is bigger than the viewer.

risks: Do not tilt the lens up at the face: it bends bodies and generators stretch them. Keep the lens level.
Slow motion plus a jump invites floating. Write a real height and real gravity.

look_makes: The camera is on the ground. The person is large against the sky.
